content.text: Add a dark-mode toggle to the notes app that persists the choice to localStorage and respects prefers-color-scheme on first visit.

thoughts.subject: Approach
thoughts.description: Store theme in a Svelte store backed by localStorage; default to matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'). Toggle a data-theme attribute on <html> and key the CSS off it.

thoughts.subject: Scope
thoughts.description: One store + a button in +layout.svelte + a few CSS variables. Keep it dependency-free.

content: I added a `theme` store that seeds from `localStorage` (falling back to the OS preference), toggles `data-theme` on `<html>`, and a ☾/☀ button in the layout. CSS variables switch on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Verified the build.
Committed as `feat: dark-mode toggle (persisted, respects OS preference)`. 🌙
